directories under them match the package. Anything outside those blocks is
ignored, so explain in comments if you need to explain.

private State propagate(RVal e, IntSet allowed, State bounds) {
    if (allowed.isEmpty() || bounds.isBottom()) return State.bottom();
    Optional<BigInteger> c = constantValue(e);
    if (c.isPresent()) {
        return allowed.contains(c.get()) ? State.top() : State.bottom();
    }
    switch (e) {
        case RVal.IntConst ic -> {
            return allowed.contains(ic.v()) ? State.top() : State.bottom();
        }
        case LVal.Local local -> {
            IntSet inter = allowed.intersection(bounds.get(local.name()));
            if (inter.isEmpty()) return State.bottom();
            return State.top().withVar(local.name(), inter);
        }
        case LVal.StaticField sf -> {
            BigInteger v = staticValue(sf);
            if (v == null) return State.top();
            return allowed.contains(v) ? State.top() : State.bottom();
        }
        case RVal.Binop binop -> {
            switch (binop.op()) {
                case Lt, Le, Gt, Ge, Eq, Ne -> {
                    boolean t = allowed.contains(ONE);
                    boolean f = allowed.contains(ZERO);
                    if (!t && !f) return State.bottom();
                    if (t && f) return State.top();
                    BinOp rel = t ? binop.op() : opposite(binop.op());
                    RVal expr = new RVal.Binop(binop.l(), BinOp.Sub, binop.r());
                    return propagate(expr, relationalAllowed(rel), bounds);
                }
                case Mult, Add, Sub -> {
                    IntSet lBounds = evalInterval(binop.l(), bounds);
                    IntSet rBounds = evalInterval(binop.r(), bounds);
                    if (lBounds.isEmpty() || rBounds.isEmpty()) return State.bottom();
                    IntSet allowedL;
                    IntSet allowedR;
                    switch (binop.op()) {
                        case Add -> {
                            allowedL = allowed.minus(rBounds).intersection(lBounds);
                            allowedR = allowed.minus(lBounds).intersection(rBounds);
                        }
                        case Sub -> {
                            allowedL = allowed.add(rBounds).intersection(lBounds);
                            allowedR = lBounds.minus(allowed).intersection(rBounds);
                        }
                        case Mult -> {
                            return propagateMult(binop.l(), binop.r(), allowed, lBounds, rBounds, bounds);
                        }
                        default -> throw new AssertionError("unreachable");
                    }
                    if (allowedL.isEmpty() || allowedR.isEmpty()) return State.bottom();
                    State cl = propagate(binop.l(), allowedL, bounds);
                    State cr = propagate(binop.r(), allowedR, bounds);
                    return cl.meet(cr);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    throw new AssertionError("unreachable");
}

private State propagate(RVal e, IntSet allowed, State bounds) {
    if (allowed.isEmpty() || bounds.isBottom()) return State.bottom();
    Optional<BigInteger> c = constantValue(e);
    if (c.isPresent()) {
        return allowed.contains(c.get()) ? State.top() : State.bottom();
    }
    switch (e) {
        case RVal.IntConst ic -> {
            return allowed.contains(ic.v()) ? State.top() : State.bottom();
        }
        case LVal.Local local -> {
            IntSet inter = allowed.intersection(bounds.get(local.name()));
            if (inter.isEmpty()) return State.bottom();
            return State.top().withVar(local.name(), inter);
        }
        case LVal.StaticField sf -> {
            BigInteger v = staticValue(sf);
            if (v == null) return State.top();
            return allowed.contains(v) ? State.top() : State.bottom();
        }
        case RVal.Binop binop -> {
            switch (binop.op()) {
                case Lt, Le, Gt, Ge, Eq, Ne -> {
                    boolean t = allowed.contains(ONE);
                    boolean f = allowed.contains(ZERO);
                    if (!t && !f) return State.bottom();
                    if (t && f) return State.top();
                    BinOp rel = t ? binop.op() : opposite(binop.op());
                    RVal expr = new RVal.Binop(binop.l(), BinOp.Sub, binop.r());
                    return propagate(expr, relationalAllowed(rel), bounds);
                }
                case Mult, Add, Sub -> {
                    IntSet lBounds = evalInterval(binop.l(), bounds);
                    IntSet rBounds = evalInterval(binop.r(), bounds);
                    if (lBounds.isEmpty() || rBounds.isEmpty()) return State.bottom();
                    IntSet allowedL;
                    IntSet allowedR;
                    switch (binop.op()) {
                        case Add -> {
                            allowedL = allowed.minus(rBounds).intersection(lBounds);
                            allowedR = allowed.minus(lBounds).intersection(rBounds);
                        }
                        case Sub -> {
                            allowedL = allowed.add(rBounds).intersection(lBounds);
                            allowedR = lBounds.minus(allowed).intersection(rBounds);
                        }
                        case Mult -> {
                            return propagateMult(binop.l(), binop.r(), allowed, lBounds, rBounds, bounds);
                        }
                        default -> throw new AssertionError("unreachable");
                    }
                    if (allowedL.isEmpty() || allowedR.isEmpty()) return State.bottom();
                    State cl = propagate(binop.l(), allowedL, bounds);
                    State cr = propagate(binop.r(), allowedR, bounds);
                    return cl.meet(cr);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    throw new AssertionError("unreachable");
}
